description: Interprets natural language edit instructions and generates edited versions of user-uploaded images. Handles all edit types: background changes, object manipulation, style transforms, color/lighting adjustments, inpainting, and replacements. Supports iterative refinement and multi-variation generation.

example_response.edit_description: Description of the edits applied to the image
example_response.edit_type: Category of edit performed (e.g., background_change, style_transfer, object_removal, color_adjustment, composite)
